title: 10x Synthetic Fleet Stress Test
preregistration: SCALE1_SPEC.md (frozen commit d65d3c8, before any execution)
load: 2320 synthetic records across ConnectedApp(+80), OrchestratorNode(+240), OrchestratorTask(+1600 incl. disclosed double-fire), SystemHeartbeat(+400); all tagged status=scale_test, customer_id=SIM-SCALE1-CORP

write_throughput.tasks_double_fire: 800 inserts (disclosed under findings, absorbed by tag teardown)
write_throughput.heartbeats: 400 inserts (response lost to session error, count verified at sweep: 1011 = 611 + 400)

read_scaling.verdict: READ PATH SUB-SECOND AT 10-26x RECORD COUNTS

aggregate_probe: group-by + sum over 1632 tasks: instant; 1600 scale_test / 22 completed / 10 in_progress, 3.35M tokens summed

falsifiers.F1_throughput: PASS - all seeded phases completed, zero insert errors after v2 fix (2320/2320 records landed)
falsifiers.F2_read_scaling: PASS - full list sweeps + aggregate at 10x complete, sub-second
falsifiers.F3_isolation: PASS - every record tagged scale_test + SIM-SCALE1-CORP; zero writes to real tenant records
falsifiers.F4_no_trigger_pollution: PASS - AegisAnomaly/AegisHealingEvent/Pattern/LearningMetric/ServiceTicket untouched; no auto-response workflow fired; zero learning contamination
falsifiers.F5_clean_teardown: PASS - 2320/2320 deleted by tag filter; post-teardown counts byte-exact to baseline (85/75/32/611)
falsifiers.F6_audit: PASS - 3 ScalingEvent records (first use of the entity) + this receipt + ledger 0093

findings: F1 (PASS): the read path is the strength - sub-second sweeps at 10-26x record counts, instant aggregation over 1632 tasks.

F2 (DISCLOSED): write path is throughput-bound at ~4-6 records/sec per connection via server-side create loop (150-250ms per record); 2320 records took ~5.5 min total. For true 10x LIVE fleet scale, batched/bulk insert APIs would be the next engineering step - not a defect, a measured boundary.
F3 (INSTRUMENT DEFECT, corrected): OrchestratorTask.priority is a string field; v1 seeder sent integers, 800 inserts rejected 800/800. Fixed in v2 (string cast), disclosed, reseeded clean.

F4 (IDEMPOTENCY FINDING): the task seed double-fired (1600 vs 800 planned) when a session error obscured a completed call and the retry re-ran it - precisely the race the stamp-before-execute amendment (Oct 13) formalized for workflows. The tag-filter teardown design absorbed the double-fire completely: teardown verified 2320/2320 by filter, not by planned count. Design validated under real conditions.
F5 (SAFETY): zero anomaly/healing/learning entities touched; entity-triggered auto-response workflows could not fire; the real fleet was never at risk.
honest_caveat: This battery proves the ENTITY-STORE scale envelope, not a live 80-app fleet scan; real app scans depend on external API latency. The 80 synthetic apps were tagged and torn down same-session; no nightly workflow ever saw them.
prototype_disclaimer: This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All data is synthetic.
